collection.title: Mercedes-Benz S Class Coupe 1993 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz S Class Coupe 1993 to 1999 (C140) requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
